metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Thunderbird hamburger menu, navigated to Settings > Composition, then Account Settings > Composition & Addressing, then Config Editor. Searched 'mail.quote' and toggled mail.quoteasblock to true, but needed to set mail.identity.id1.auto_quote to false.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Thunderbird menus, navigate Settings sections (General, Composition), open Account Settings, open Config Editor, search preferences, toggle boolean values
metadata.failure_analysis: Model found Config Editor and searched for related preferences but modified the wrong one (mail.quoteasblock instead of mail.identity.id1.auto_quote). The correct preference was not discoverable via the 'mail.quote' search term.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to toggling a visible checkbox in General settings. Smooth scrolling checkbox is directly visible without needing Config Editor, matching model's ability to navigate Settings UI.
metadata.explanation: Task requires unchecking 'Use smooth scrolling' in Settings > General. Evaluator checks general.smoothScroll is false in prefs.js after closing Thunderbird.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches prefs.js from the Thunderbird profile directory, which stores user preferences including smooth scrolling setting.
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird before reading prefs.js, ensuring preferences are flushed to disk.
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js and checks that general.smoothScroll equals false, which is the correct preference key for smooth scrolling in Thunderbird.
Expected value handling is correct: get_rule returns the rules dict directly, and the metric accesses it via rule.get('expect', {}), properly matching the expected parameter format.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (disable smooth scrolling) is fully verified by checking the single relevant preference.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
